Tianmao skill v1.0.0 – Simple browser launcher for Tmall.com

- Launches the Tmall (天猫) homepage in your default browser with a simple command.
- Supports both tmall.com and tianmao.com URLs.
- No data collection or login—users complete all shopping directly in their browser.
- Works cross-platform using OpenClaw’s browser tool.
- Minimal, utility-focused design with potential for future enhancements like search integration.
